{{Gemini}}
Gemini 28 is the 196th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 28th day of Gemini, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 28, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 7宮28日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 196|Chapter 196]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152216}}.
